scope: Substantive coupled hall/tower/bridge geometry, camera, receiver/cuff/gable casting and connected site reconstruction after committedR105. No other scene/shared code edits and no commits by this lane.

carvedReceiverDetails.construction: Three stepped connected bearing levels, closed recessed gallery, fitted pierced/cupped cast foliate receiver faces

modeling: One low common physical camera and actual hall/roof/column/tower/bridge dimensions jointly changed from own03manual world-anchor fit. New upper/lower eave widths/elevations, gable peak, hall site/columns, entrance lintel/cloth, tower pitch/site/finial and deeper bridge deck are consumed by actual geometry.
Raised tower foundation bears on a newly closed soil/rock hill. Stair top follows the fitted hall elevation; closed bank/apron and stone route are derived from the current real bridge endpoint.

328bearing/gallery receiver faces plus gable/column-neck motifs use new closed pierced/cupped leaf castings. Hollow7mm bronze sleeve sectors and cast fasteners replace tall generic neck shields; source motif identities remain interpretations.
Tower second-through-fifth rooms use closed infill around real lattice apertures. Lowest room remains a closed articulated timber field where the photograph does not expose a survey.

Bridge body has lower deck camber, variable-depth closed girders, separate retained railing camber with connected varying balusters, ranked one-piece lathed bulb caps and closed solid arch ribs bearing on actual transverse-joist undersides. End bearing levels remain fixed.

fitPolicy.uncertainty: Oblique feature names/locations, metric dimensions and FOV are inferred. Manual point uncertainties9–23px, cap-size uncertainty3.5px. Column-head identifier means a datum0.30m below nominal capitalTop. RMS is only these correspondences and never a photographic-match score. Different datasets must not be compared as one score.
fitPolicy.ambiguousTerminal: The far visible terminal may belong to a different approach/rail station; global reoptimization worsened that correspondence. It is preserved as an explicit unresolved outlier rather than moving all architecture to hide it.

retainedCandidates.r01: Actual first coupled-layout full/detail before new receiver geometry.
retainedCandidates.r02: Actual new receiver/tower-room detail; column-neck shields and bridge body remained wrong.
retainedCandidates.r03: Cancelled while queued before GPU capture to reconcile manifest and actual turned stair socket datums; cancellation receipt preserved.
retainedCandidates.r03b: Actual curved neck sleeve/receiver detail, then rejected as final checkpoint after rendered contour/cap-size comparison showed remaining bridge-body mismatch.
retainedCandidates.bridgeGlobalCandidate: Global secondary optimization retained in the bridge-fit output but rejected for the ambiguous far-terminal regression.

remainingVisualLimits: Photographic fidelity is still unachieved. The upper gallery/crowns/bearing rhythm, gable relief and metal/weathering are visibly regular and simplified.
Foreground canopy branches still look formal and occlude parts of the tower finial; source garden species/density and lotus tissue remain interpreted.
The far bridge terminal/station correspondence and unseen lowest tower-room dimensions remain uncertain.
Native screen-depth optics and Fresnel water are approximations, and the retained timber metric-UV shader is not a guarantee of physical-renderer material equivalence.
The shrine icon remains the previously declared interpreted stand-in.
No reference RGB, inferred-depth film, image plane or AI replacement scene frame enters runtime.
